report.explanation: Current telemetry contradicts the operator hypothesis: all sampled checkout traces returned HTTP 200 across order, inventory, payment and postgres, and order metrics show only 200s on /v1/orders with zero 502s. The deployment record shows only baseline order v1.0.0 with no prior version, so it cannot establish a deployment-caused fault. No bounded cause is substantiated; hand off.
missing_evidence: Error/failure traces or logs showing checkout errors (non-200 responses) during the incident window
Order service logs (excluded from context) to confirm or refute error occurrence
Gateway logs (excluded from context) to confirm client-observed checkout failures
Deployment history showing a version change preceding any observed error onset
